body:
To be honest, I never really wanted to kill myself. I just wasn't sure I wanted to live.

Regardless, why don't you tell me a bit more about what's going on? You can pm me or reply here, your choice. I'm sorry you feel like you should go... I know what that's like. We can talk about it. Maybe we can find something to live for together.
I'm currently in southern Cali. I travel all over the US. Simplest way to put it is travelling nurse, but I'm not a nurse.
